title: 第14章 薛雾一第15章 薛雾二
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
眼前的银色字迹不断浮现，甚至因为速度太快，几乎出现了重叠现象。
同一时间。
胡隆感受到像是有一丝丝冰凉的气流顺着左手的食指尖接触的地方涌入身躯。
见状。
胡隆目光微动。
很快注意到了不同之处。
他的手指触碰的是石台上一条牙签粗细的枯败根须。
这一枝条正是从这尊菩萨像站在的莲花台子一处木质缝隙内延伸出来的。
作为木雕，等同是死亡，按理说已经失去了光合作用，没有了生理机能。
是不可能生长出枝条的。
不过这也不是绝对的。
若是细小的孢子，或者或种子被风带到木雕的缝隙凹槽之中，从中生长而出也不是不可能。
对此他没有过多理会。
让他在意的是另外一点，他将手拿开，那种清凉气流瞬间消失，眼前不断增长的源值也停了下来。
在保持着触碰的动作后，那种感觉又重新出现了。
很显然，这些微弱的清凉气流应该就是源值的本身。
至于之前晒太阳为什么没有这种感觉。
或许是因为增长的源值太少所致，清凉气流太过细微，无法察觉。
而这次是因为源值太多太密，才出现这种感觉，也就是量变引起质变。
明白了这点后。

胡隆没有理会这点，抬头看了一眼四周。
见到没有人注意到自己。
便假装低头祷告。
源值还在不断增长，短短几十秒，就让面板之上的源值突破两位数。
不过，在此之后，源值增长的速度明显减慢不少。
但是依然在增长，平静一两秒就会增长0.01缕。
又持续了一会儿。
字迹彻底消失，眼前没有再浮现出字迹。
“没了吗？”
胡隆心中微动，眼中流露出一丝可惜。
那种清凉的气流感也渐渐消失不见。
又用手触碰了一下这道根须，但是没有任何的反应。
像是刚才的一切只是一个幻觉。
见此。
他心中一动，唤出了太素面板。
目光看向最后的源值一栏。
【源值:16.21缕】
原本他的源值只有4缕多。
这一下直接增长了十几缕。
这次收获不菲。

单单是这一下，就抵得上他晒近四个月的太阳。
content_en:
The silver writing in front of me kept appearing, and it almost overlapped because it was so fast.
at the same time.
Hu Long felt as if a stream of cold air flowed into his body along the point where the tip of his left index finger touched.
See this.
Hu Long's eyes moved slightly.
The difference was quickly noticed.
What his fingers touched was a withered root as thick as a toothpick on the stone platform.
This branch extends from a wooden gap on the lotus platform where the Bodhisattva stands.
As a wood sculpture, it is equivalent to death. It stands to reason that it has lost photosynthesis and no physiological functions.
It is impossible to grow branches.
But this is not absolute.
If tiny spores or seeds are carried by the wind into the cracks and grooves of the wood carving, it is not impossible for them to grow out of them.
He didn't pay much attention to this.
What concerned him was another point. When he took his hand away, the cool air flow disappeared instantly, and the growing Source Value in front of him also stopped.
After maintaining the touch, the feeling reappeared.
Obviously, these weak cool air currents should be the source value itself.
As for why I didn’t feel this way when I was in the sun before.
Perhaps it was because the source value of the increase was too small, and the cool air flow was too subtle to be noticed.
But this time, this feeling occurred because the source values ​​were too many and too dense, that is, quantitative changes caused qualitative changes.
After understanding this.
Hu Long ignored this and looked up at his surroundings.
No one noticed me.
Then he pretended to bow his head and pray.
The source value is still growing, and in just a few dozen seconds, the source value on the panel exceeds double digits.
However, after that, the growth rate of source value slowed down significantly.
But it is still growing, and it will grow by 0.01 rays after a second or two of calmness.
This went on for a while longer.
The handwriting disappeared completely, and there was no more writing in front of my eyes.
"Is it gone?"
Hu Long's heart moved slightly, and there was a trace of pity in his eyes.
The cool feeling of air also gradually disappeared.
I touched the root with my hand again, but there was no reaction.
As if everything just now was just an illusion.
See this.
With a thought in his mind, he summoned the Taisu panel.
Look at the last source value column.
[Source value: 16.21 wisps]
Originally, his source value was just over 4 strands.
This time, it grew to more than a dozen strands.
This time the harvest was huge.
This one shot alone was worth nearly four months of sunshine.
